text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear paragraphing with introduction, body reasons, and conclusion","quality":"organizational control","description":"The essay is better structured into distinct parts that help guide the reader through its argument."},{"evidence":"multiple connected reasons with transitions like \"Another reason\" and \"One other major reason\"","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay develops its position with several supporting points instead of relying on a single brief claim."},{"evidence":"more sustained argumentative focus across the whole response","quality":"task consistency","description":"The essay stays on one line of argument and keeps supporting the same main claim throughout."},{"evidence":"phrases like \"focus on there academics,\" \"save up for a higher education,\" and \"work expires\"","quality":"academic vocabulary","description":"The essay uses more school-related and argument-relevant words to express its ideas."},{"evidence":"longer sentences with clauses joined by \"because,\" \"so,\" and \"if\"","quality":"syntactic complexity","description":"The essay shows more ability to combine ideas into multi-clause sentences."},{"evidence":"less frequent breakdowns that interrupt meaning compared with Essay A's many unclear stretches","quality":"clarity of expression","description":"The essay communicates its points more clearly and is easier to follow overall."}]}
